h1: Audio visual and collaboration, from one accountable contractor
lede: Purview designs and delivers high-performance AV environments for enterprise, corporate fit-out, hospitality and education: from a single boardroom to multi-zone campus deployments, with IT, AV and networking under one contract and senior leadership on site from kick-off to handover.

blocks.text: IT, AV and networking: three disciplines, one contractor

Complex commercial projects fail in the gaps between trades. Purview removes the gaps by delivering all three disciplines with one team, so the AV-over-IP network, the structured cabling and the conferencing rooms are designed together and commissioned together.

blocks.text: From design intent to a signed-off room

items.title: Design and engineering
items.body: Detailed AV design documentation, signal flow diagrams, rack elevations and BOMs produced by certified AV engineers. All designs align to AVIXA and InfoComm standards.

items.title: Supply and installation
items.body: Direct procurement from tier-1 manufacturers. Installations executed by trained and certified technicians, with structured cable management and full labelling.

items.title: Control programming
items.body: In-house Crestron, AMX and Q-SYS programmers. Custom UI design, room logic and API integrations with third-party systems: BMS, IT and unified communications platforms.

items.title: Commissioning and handover
items.body: Full system testing against design intent, SAT and FAT documentation, end-user training and an as-built documentation package delivered at project close-out.

blocks.text: Rooms we have built
Large-scale, technically complex AV and IT integration across commercial, corporate and hospitality environments. Client names withheld; references available on request.
40+ rooms across three floors
Scope: Q-SYS AV-over-IP system, video wall with multi-touch presentation, Sennheiser ceiling microphone arrays, Q-SYS Core DSP, Zoom Rooms and Teams Room integration, DTMF dialling.
Technical highlight: custom control programming with Active Directory user authentication and room-booking panel sync via REST API to Microsoft Exchange.
200+ display endpoints
Scope: lobby, lifts and floor wayfinding; Scala content management, HDBaseT distribution, emergency override integration with the BMS.
Technical highlight: network-segmented VLAN architecture with QoS policy, deployed with the incumbent IT team. Zero-downtime cutover during live occupation.
Built entirely on Teams-certified components
Scope: design, supply, installation and commissioning of a Microsoft Teams Rooms solution for a large conferencing space.

Technical highlight: Poly Studio E70 dual 4K sensors with DirectorAI speaker tracking, Biamp Devio SCX 400 multi-channel AEC and AI noise reduction, Logitech Tap and Scribe, dual 85-inch displays for simultaneous far-end video and content.
Single and dual display standards, BYOD ready
Scope: focus and small conference spaces plus medium rooms running Microsoft Teams Room with BYOD capability.
Technical highlight: single-display standard for smaller spaces, dual-display with speaker tracking for medium and large rooms, content camera for whiteboarding integrated with the Teams Room.
Dual projectors, two cameras, one touch
Scope: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows for a multi-purpose room; MTR deployment, Biamp Launch acoustic commissioning, Extron control programming, end-user handover.
Technical highlight: Biamp Parlé beam-tracking microphones and ceiling speakers through a Teams-certified Biamp DSP; Extron automates display power, source switching and routing.
Recreation space for employees and partners
Technical highlight: dual display solution with Bose in-ceiling directional speakers and subwoofer, QSC touch panel programmed to switch between game mode and music mode.
Office wayfinding and visitor welcome
Technical highlight: touch display with Logitech RoomMate as the signage player, content served from local and remote sources through the CMS.
Room Kit EQ on a mobile Heckler cart
Scope: 85-inch display on a Heckler cart with Cisco Room Kit EQ; cart assembly, display integration, configuration, cabling and onboarding to Webex Control Hub.

Technical highlight: AI camera framing, noise removal and voice optimisation natively certified for Webex; integrated codec, speakers and microphone array; central remote management through Control Hub.
Senior leadership on site at every milestone, not just kick-off

blocks.text: Three support tiers
Remote helpdesk
Business-hours remote support by phone, email and remote diagnostics. Ideal for minor faults and user queries.
On-site response
Scheduled and reactive on-site visits covering hardware fault resolution, software updates and system reconfiguration.
Managed services
Fully managed AV and IT environment: proactive monitoring, quarterly preventative maintenance, dedicated account manager and priority emergency response.
